description: Create the subscription infrastructure: SubscriptionContext (localStorage-backed), LockedRoute wrapper component, UnlockPage, and SubscriptionsPage. These are the building blocks that FEAT-002 will wire into the app.
steps: 1. Create src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx. Define ModuleDefinition interface (key: string, name: string, group: 'admin'|'rider', free: boolean). Define the full MODULES array: Free admin = ['/admin','Dashboard'], ['/admin/orders','Orders'], ['/admin/menu','Menu Items'], ['/admin/dine-in','Dine In & QR']; Locked admin = ['/admin/deals','Deals'], ['/admin/categories','Categories'], ['/admin/coupons','Coupons'], ['/admin/customers','Customers'], ['/admin/riders','Riders'], ['/admin/delivery-zones','Delivery Zones'], ['/admin/reviews','Reviews'], ['/admin/settings','Settings']; Free rider = ['/rider','Dashboard'], ['/rider/orders','Active Orders'], ['/rider/profile','Profile']; Locked rider = ['/rider/map','Live Map'], ['/rider/earnings','Earnings'], ['/rider/wallet','Wallet'], ['/rider/history','History'], ['/rider/schedule','Schedule'], ['/rider/notifications','Notifications'], ['/rider/chat','Chat Support'], ['/rider/reviews','Reviews'], ['/rider/performance','Performance'], ['/rider/documents','Documents'], ['/rider/help','Help Center'], ['/rider/settings','Settings']. Context holds unlockedModules string[] in state, persisted to localStorage key 'pizza_king_modules' as JSON array. isModuleLocked(key) returns false for free modules regardless of stored state, true for locked modules not in unlockedModules. unlockModule adds to array and saves, lockModule removes and saves. Export SubscriptionProvider, useSubscription hook. Follow the exact pattern from src/contexts/CartContext.tsx (createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect for persistence, typed context interface, throw if used outside provider).

2. Create src/components/LockedRoute.tsx. Props: moduleKey (string), children (ReactNode). Calls useSubscription().isModuleLocked(moduleKey). If locked, looks up the module name from useSubscription().modules, then renders <Navigate to={`/unlock?module=${encodeURIComponent(moduleKey)}&name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`} replace />. If not locked, renders children wrapped in a Fragment. Import Navigate and useLocation from react-router-dom.

3. Create src/pages/UnlockPage.tsx. Standalone page (no AdminLayout or RiderLayout). Uses useSearchParams to read ?module= and ?name=. Renders: full-screen centered layout with a Lock icon (lucide-react, w-16 h-16 text-yellow-500), an h1 'Premium Feature' subtitle with the module name, a short paragraph 'This module is part of the Pizza King Pro plan. Unlock all premium features to access it.', a 'Go Back' Button (variant='outline', calls useNavigate()(-1)), a 'Manage Subscriptions' Button (variant='secondary', uses Link to='/admin/subscriptions'), and a 'Buy All Modules — Unlock Everything' Button styled with className='bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-600 text-white hover:opacity-90' linking to '#'. Use Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle from @/components/ui/card and Button from @/components/ui/button.

4. Create src/pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage.tsx. Wrapped in <AdminLayout title='Subscriptions'>. Import useSubscription from @/contexts/SubscriptionContext, Switch from @/components/ui/switch, Badge from @/components/ui/badge, Card/CardContent/CardHeader/CardTitle from @/components/ui/card, Button from @/components/ui/button, Crown and Lock icons from lucide-react. Page heading: Crown icon + 'Module Subscriptions' h1 + subtitle 'Toggle which modules are active. Free modules are always available.'. Two sections ('Admin Modules', 'Rider Modules') each rendered as a responsive grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4). Each card: module name as CardTitle, route key as small muted text, a Switch (checked=!isModuleLocked(key), onCheckedChange toggling lockModule/unlockModule, disabled for free modules), and for free modules an 'Always Free' Badge (variant='secondary'). Footer: 'Buy All Modules' Button styled bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-600 text-white.
acceptance_criteria: src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx exports SubscriptionProvider and useSubscription with correct TypeScript types
src/components/LockedRoute.tsx redirects to /unlock?module=...&name=... when module is locked, renders children when unlocked
src/pages/UnlockPage.tsx renders without crashing and shows Lock icon, module name from query params, three buttons
src/pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage.tsx renders inside AdminLayout with admin and rider module cards, switches work for non-free modules
npm run build completes with exit code 0 after all four files are created (even before App.tsx is updated, the build will pass because the files are not yet imported)

findings: All four files created and build passes (exit 0). Notes for FEAT-002: (1) SubscriptionProvider must be added to the React tree in main.tsx or App.tsx wrapping everything, before LockedRoute or SubscriptionsPage will work at runtime. (2) LockedRoute is a default export at src/components/LockedRoute.tsx — wrap protected route elements with <LockedRoute moduleKey='/admin/deals'>...</LockedRoute> in App.tsx. (3) UnlockPage needs a route at /unlock in App.tsx (no auth guard, no layout wrapper). (4) SubscriptionsPage needs a route at /admin/subscriptions inside the admin route tree. (5) LockedRoute passes location state ({ from: location }) to the Navigate redirect so the UnlockPage or a post-purchase handler could navigate back if needed. (6) All pre-existing build warnings (chunk size, push.ts dynamic import) are unchanged — not introduced by these files.
